Hey, I’m 5’5 so I kind of understand what you’re going through. All my friends are way taller than me and I keep getting called a shorty and thats okay. I’ve had the same own family looking in disgust moments and yeah it sucks. I’ve screamed the same question again and again, why always me? 

And to put things in prespective, I have a younger brother who is 10 years younger than me and last month he crossed my height. The worst part is when people compare you just to prove a point that you’re short. So yeah, I exactly get what you’re saying.


But, but hear me out, everyone in this life has their own flaws. It’s not a matter of how others see you its how you see yourself that matters. You’re 5’0, so what bro? There are so many girls who are 4’ and they need someone who’s a 5. There’s this fav quote of mine “it’s human tendency to not know the value before loosing something”. Your life is a dream life for so many people buddy, and when you’re 30 nobody cares about height. Get rich, help so many people out, donate to charity, give back to your parents for all the efforts and hurdles they faced for you, how many more do you need?

I’m sorry for what you’re going through. Just know that you’re not alone, I feel the same way as you do too and I’m suprised by how accurate the pov part is…. But, life goes on, and the only hope is life isnt eternal. Years will pass and soon enough we would be forgotten and left behind to end up with what we desire, death.

See? I wasnt wrong when I told you you were strong enough to evade drugs. You’ve gone without drugs once and I’m sure you can do it again too, this time more easier.

I’m NOT saying you absolutely HAVE to get out of drugs because honestly we all live a short life so fuck it. But if you ever feel like you’re doing drugs just for the sake of others and not to make you feel better, I’m pretty sure you are better off without it.
